messages.author: 31e7ef40ac1e8c51
messages.subject: Error on deployment of Shiny App - Object 'N' not found
parts:
Hi, I'm running a very basic app with a drop-down menu to select a drink brand (text options) which are listed in a variable called 'N'. I've encoded the text as UTF8 as per a prior post where this caused a similar error. However, the error continues to appear with the server version of Shiny not recognising my variable despite the text being encoded as per Shiny's requirements. The app works like a charm on my PC (Win7 64 bit). 

N <- enc2utf8(SWrnames)

Shiny error:

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : object 'N' not found
Calls: local ... tryCatch -> tryCatchList -> tryCatchOne -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted

Error logs below. Any ideas as to why N is the only object not found?

Thanks,

David

messages.author: 31e7ef40ac1e8c51
messages.subject: Re: Error on deployment of Shiny App - Object 'N' not found
parts:
Hi Joshua - Thanks for the further query.

N is declared in the main script and assigned a list of brands, and then viewed to ensure that the data is there. Script updated to encode the text as UTF8 for compatibility in Shiny

N <- enc2utf8(SWrnames)
View(N)

Then in the Shiny App, N is used as the source for the drop-down menu, with the chosen brand stored as 'SKU'

      selectInput(inputId = "SKU",
                label = "Select a Scotch Whiskey:",
                choices =  N,
                multiple = FALSE,
                selectize = FALSE,
                width = '400px',
                size = NA),
      textOutput("result")

Then in the output section, the chosen brand, SKU, is matched against N, the list of brands, to give the index number of the chosen brand to then select the appropriate brand's data to pull into the chart:

   output$scatterPlot <- renderPlot({
    View(input$SKU)
    Choice <- match(input$SKU,N)
    View(Choice)
   
    Xvar <- ObservedOverExpected[Choice]
    Yvar <- Observed[Choice]
 
    XYPlot <- data.frame(Xvar,Yvar)
   
    X<- XYPlot[1]
    Y<- XYPlot[2]
   
    ggplot(XYPlot, aes(Xvar, Yvar))  + geom_point() +geom_smooth() + ggtitle(N[Choice]) +xlab("Observed over Expected") +ylab("Observed") + geom_text(label=SWrnames, color="#008b30", size=2, nudge_x = 0.00, nudge_y = 0.00, check_overlap = T)

Works like a charm on my PC, but N not recognised as a variable on the Shiny server. Any help on this appreciated!

Best regards,

David

El mar., 29 may. 2018 15:32, Joshua Spiewak <j...@rstudio.com> escribió:

When you say that N is declared in the "main script" and that View is called just after it, I would not expect View to work on shinyapps.io.
So could you please describe your file structure, how you are constructing your ui and server, and calling any additional R files?

On Thursday, May 24, 2018 at 5:11:17 AM UTC-4, Da...@market-emergence.com wrote:
Hi Joshua - Thanks for the further query.

N is declared in the main script and assigned a list of brands, and then viewed to ensure that the data is there. Script updated to encode the text as UTF8 for compatibility in Shiny

N <- enc2utf8(SWrnames)
View(N)

Then in the Shiny App, N is used as the source for the drop-down menu, with the chosen brand stored as 'SKU'

      selectInput(inputId = "SKU",
                label = "Select a Scotch Whiskey:",
                choices =  N,
                multiple = FALSE,
                selectize = FALSE,
                width = '400px',
                size = NA),
      textOutput("result")

Then in the output section, the chosen brand, SKU, is matched against N, the list of brands, to give the index number of the chosen brand to then select the appropriate brand's data to pull into the chart:

   output$scatterPlot <- renderPlot({
    View(input$SKU)
    Choice <- match(input$SKU,N)
    View(Choice)
   
    Xvar <- ObservedOverExpected[Choice]
    Yvar <- Observed[Choice]
 
    XYPlot <- data.frame(Xvar,Yvar)
   
    X<- XYPlot[1]
    Y<- XYPlot[2]
   
    ggplot(XYPlot, aes(Xvar, Yvar))  + geom_point() +geom_smooth() + ggtitle(N[Choice]) +xlab("Observed over Expected") +ylab("Observed") + geom_text(label=SWrnames, color="#008b30", size=2, nudge_x = 0.00, nudge_y = 0.00, check_overlap = T)

Works like a charm on my PC, but N not recognised as a variable on the Shiny server. Any help on this appreciated!

Best regards,

David


On Tuesday, May 22, 2018 at 5:31:23 PM UTC+1, da...@market-emergence.com wrote:
Hi, I'm running a very basic app with a drop-down menu to select a drink brand (text options) which are listed in a variable called 'N'. I've encoded the text as UTF8 as per a prior post where this caused a similar error. However, the error continues to appear with the server version of Shiny not recognising my variable despite the text being encoded as per Shiny's requirements. The app works like a charm on my PC (Win7 64 bit). 

N <- enc2utf8(SWrnames)

Error in value[[3L]](cond) : object 'N' not found
